overview: Signal Garden is a timed garden route-planning game about restoring a chain of lantern relays. Collect gold sparks, carry only three at once and charge six relays in order before the eight-minute signal expires. Pink patrols threaten both health and cargo, while the safe central beacon offers limited healing.
rules: Carry up to three sparks; each of six numbered relays requires three sparks and must be restored in order.
Hold interact beside the correct relay to charge it, then return to the cyan beacon and hold interact to finish.
Pink patrols take a heart and a spark. Spending one spark creates a three-second shield.
Spark pads refill every 15 seconds; the beacon heals once every 30 seconds.
Complete the chain before the eight-minute signal runs out.
controls: Enter/Space/controller A starts; WASD/arrows/left stick moves.
Hold E to charge/heal/finish; Q/controller LB spends a spark on a shield.
R/Enter/controller A restarts after win/loss; F5/F9 save/resume.
story: Restore the garden’s failing lantern signal during a long night. The available source does not establish a named story cast.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
